description: Auto-fit responsive grid: as many columns as fit the minimum width, then wrap. Attribute form: data-layout="grid".

attributes.name: data-layout-min
attributes.description: Minimum column width before wrapping: 8 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25rem. One-off lengths: style="--layout-min: 220px".

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between cells, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-layout-subgrid
attributes.description: Children become subgrid rows so header/content/footer align across cells. Bare = span 3 rows; 2 or 4 for other card shapes.
